24.content:
# claude.md - Delta Post Accident (tree 683028422)

Unlinked memory node. Read FIRST before editing this tree; update it every edit session.
Quest Diagnostics / Delta Air Lines post-accident + reasonable-suspicion drug & alcohol
testing determination.

## PII / PHI + COMPLIANCE NOTICE
This tree captures drug/alcohol testing determinations, employee roles, injury/medical
status, OSM member ID, internal notes, and contact name/phone; it stages sf_*__c fields
that feed Salesforce and sends TWO automatic external notification emails
(email_send_now="1", no confirmation step) on every session that reaches node 20. This is
PII/PHI and DOT-compliance sensitive. Any LIVE publish/import must be reviewed by a
teammate per Zingtree policy before it ships. Do not push to the live tree from an
automated build.

## Purpose
Agent-facing decision flow that classifies a Delta incident (DOT / Non-DOT / Reasonable
Suspicion / No-Testing), computes the testing determination + sample-collection routing
(airport/base-specific rules, provider sequencing), stages a Salesforce payload, and sends
the internal summary + OSM notification emails.

## Architecture / node map (story order)
- 1  Content  Incident Classification - DOT Check (3 major-accident radios). ROOT. -> 2
- 2  Content  Employee, Airport & Notes -- captures employee_role, sf_Airport_Code__c,
              sf_Member_ID_Number__c, sf_Internal_Notes__c ONCE, upstream of every branch
              (CR-001 R11/R14/A1). Every path below inherits these answers before any
              determination or payload is built. -> 3
- 3  Scoring  DOT vs Non-DOT Routing (advanced logic, raw form-field expression --
              pre-existing, unaffected by CR-001) -> 4 (any node-1 answer Yes) | 5 (else)
- 4  Content  DOT Incident - Stop and Call Delta (sets is_manual_dot="true") -> 19
- 5  Scoring  Is Suspicion? (sf_Event_Type == "Suspicion") -> 6 (suspicion) | 10 (else)
- 6  Content  Suspicion Reasoning (suspicion_reason, drugs_alcohol_suspicion; employee_role
              field REMOVED here -- captured once at node 2, CR-001 R14) -> 7
- 7  Script   Reasonable Suspicion Testing Determination -- suspicion classification
              PRODUCER (WFH hotline / DOT hotline / NON-DOT two-manager checklist).
              Untouched by CR-001; feeds the shared engine via
              testing_classification/testing_summary_html. -> 8
- 8  Scoring  Is DOT Employee? (op-based router on employee_role) -> 19 (Other, direct) |
              9 (Work From Home Employee) | 25 (else -- DOT role, via dedicated
              Reasonable-Suspicion DOT alert -- was routed to node 4 until 2026-08-27)
- 9  Content  Work From Home Suspicion (hotline alert) -> 19
- 25 Content  Reasonable Suspicion - DOT Role: Testing Required (dedicated DOT-role
              suspicion alert; added 2026-08-27 so DOT-role suspicion cases no longer
              see node 4's accident-specific "major accident criteria was answered Yes"
              copy) -> 19
- 10 Content  No-Testing Factor Assessment (over-32h, weather, minor, fault,
              hours_elapsed conditional on >32h=="No" -- CR-001 R15 PRESERVED) -> 11
- 11 Scoring  No-Testing Factor Routing (advanced logic, all 4 exemptions met) -> 12 | 13
- 12 Content  No Testing Required (sf_Additional_Notes__c narrative only;
              sf_Member_ID_Number__c REMOVED here -- dup of node 2, CR-001 R14) -> 19
- 13 Content  Select Damage Type (repeatable damage_type radio) -> 14
- 14 Script   Iterate Damage Type Selections (cursor loop) -> 15
- 15 Content  Assessment per Damage Type (per-type conditional fields + notes + fault) -> 16
- 16 Script   Store Selections (push record to transforms.final_records) -> 17
- 17 Scoring  Is More Damage Types? -> 14 (loop) | 18
- 18 Script   Testing Determination Routing -- accident/damage classification PRODUCER
              (no-testing exemptions, medical-care deferral, drug-only 8-32h window,
              per-damage-type qualification). Untouched by CR-001; feeds the shared engine.
              -> 19
- 19 Script   Finalize Determination & Stage SF Payload -- THE UNIFIED ENGINE (CR-001 R12).
              Replaces old nodes 32 + 51. Normalizes employee_role/airport, computes the
              canonical DOT/account-number rule (CR-001 R13), runs the shared airport-
              routing tables, aggregates notes (incl. sf_Internal_Notes__c, new),
              builds final_print_summary_html/_text + the SF payload. Consumed by BOTH the
              accident/damage branch (18) and the reasonable-suspicion branch (7/8/9/4). ->
              20
- 20 Content  Summary (renders ${transforms.final_print_summary_html}; captures
              email_address). THE ONLY result/summary screen an agent sees (CR-001 R14 --
              old node 15's separate "Assessment Result" screen is gone). -> 21
- 21 Email    Testing Required Internal Notification (email_send_now="1") -> 22
- 22 Email    OSM Notification -- email_body contains a literal link to the Post Collection
              Flow tree (https://zingtree.com/live/173598167?zv_sf_Id=${sf_Id}#910); this is
              plain text inside the HTML body, not a Zingtree cross-tree node reference, so
              it needs no remapping when this tree is renumbered. -> 23
- 23 Content  Session Complete (terminal screen; was "New Node", CR-001 R19 retitle)
- 24 Content  claude.md (this node, unlinked -- no inbound edges, excluded from the flow)

## Determination sources (single-source-of-truth notes)
- Accident/damage/no-testing family: node 18 is the classification producer for the
  accident branch (DOT-trigger / deferred / no-testing / damage-qualifying). It feeds
  node 19 (the shared engine) via testing_classification/testing_summary_html.
- The no-testing path (10 -> 11 -> 12) does NOT run node 18 or any other producer --
  this is a PRE-EXISTING gap carried forward unchanged from the source baseline (node 12
  goes straight to node 19, same as old node 9 -> old node 32). Node 19's testing_summary_html
  fallback ("Testing Summary Unavailable") is what actually renders on this path today.
  Discovered during this build, confirmed out of scope for CR-001 (R3/R4 are explicitly
  unaffected) -- NOT fixed here. Flagged for a future CR if Brent wants a real "No Testing
  Required" determination card on this specific path (the abandoned v4 WIP branch's node 4
  attempted this fix but was not adopted into this build).
- Reasonable-suspicion family: node 7 is the producer (deliberately separate per the
  2026-06-24 Quest decision -- RS is its own question set, same tree).
- Node 19 is the ONLY place either producer's output is consumed into a final payload --
  no more duplicated tail logic (old nodes 32 and 51 are gone).

## Data dictionary (key vars)
- Inbound query params: sf_Event_Type (Suspicion triggers RS), sf_Id, sf_Contact_Name__c,
  sf_Contact_Phone__c, sf_Department_Number__c, email (all read via merge fields in the two
  email bodies, not by any script).
- Node 1 radios (unchanged): sf_Specimen_Requested__c (major accident -- name/label
  mismatch is a pre-existing SFDC field-mapping quirk, out of scope), sf_Is_the_aircraft_destroyed__c,
  sf_Are_there_any_fatalities__c.
- Node 2 (NEW, upstream capture): employee_role, sf_Airport_Code__c, sf_Member_ID_Number__c,
  sf_Internal_Notes__c. Each captured EXACTLY ONCE tree-wide as of this build.
- is_manual_dot: hidden field, set "true" on node 4 (immediate-DOT shortcut); folded into
  node 19's isDotAccident calc; forces isDot=true regardless of role/accident answers
  (CR-001 R15 preserved).
- No-testing factors (node 10): sf_Minor_or_cosmetic_damage__c,
  sf_Fault_due_to_mechanical_equipment_fail__c, sf_Incident_caused_by_weather__c (carries a
  pre-existing stub empty conditional config -- {"conditional":{"simple":[{"variable":"","op":"","value":""}]}}
  -- harmless no-op, predates this build, NOT fixed here per the v4-reconciliation
  instruction: only the claude.md node was carried forward from the abandoned v4 WIP
  branch, not its undocumented fixes), sf_Over_32_hours_since_incident__c (drives the
  No-Testing determination), hours_elapsed (conditional on >32h=="No"; feeds node 18's
  drug-only 8-32h window -- CR-001 R15 PRESERVED, NOT removed as the v4 WIP branch did).
- transforms.final_records: array of per-damage-type records (built at node 16).
- testing_classification / testing_summary_html / testing_summary_text: set by whichever
  producer ran (18 or 7); read by node 19 with a fallback string if empty (see the
  no-testing-path gap above).
- Node 19 canonical vars: isDotRole, isDotAccident, isDot, isWFH, hotlineRequired (CR-001
  R13) -- one rule, both branches. sf_Account_Number__c = hotlineRequired ? "80126730" :
  "80126731". sf_Delta_Post_Accident_Authority__c AND sf_Reasonable_Suspicion_Authority__c
  are BOTH dual-written to the same canonical value (isDot ? "DOT" : "NDOT") so either
  SFDC field name reads the correct, now-unified value regardless of which branch ran.
- Summary transforms (all set at node 19): final_print_summary_html/_text,
  sample_collection_summary_html/_text (identical to final_print_summary_*, kept for
  naming continuity with the pre-CR-001 tree), testing_summary_html/_text (passthrough),
  base_city_specific_instructions, provider_routing_instructions, collection_team_notes.
- Removed as dead outputs during the R12 merge (write-only, non-SFDC-prefixed, never read
  by any script or merge field in the source baseline): delta_hotline_call_required,
  delta_hotline_call_message, delta_stp_call_required, delta_stp_call_message. The
  information they carried still renders in the HTML/text summary (Delta STP Call row,
  Action Required / NON-DOT Checklist card) -- only the redundant unread scalars were cut.
- sf_Internal_Notes__c: captured at node 2, staged only (SFDC out-of-band contract field,
  same pattern as the other sf_*__c fields per the requirements doc's Integrations
  section) AND now also rendered as an "Internal Notes" card in the final summary when
  non-empty (new in this build -- previously captured but never read anywhere, a genuine
  dead-output finding; rendering it fulfils R12's "aggregates notes" and closes the gap).
  Flagged for Brent to confirm this display choice.

## External systems
No in-tree Connected Object / CX Action call exists in this tree. The sf_*__c fields are a
data contract that Quest's Salesforce embed reads back out-of-band after the session ends
-- not a live API call from inside the tree (per the requirements doc, Assumption A3).
Two Zingtree-native automatic emails (nodes 21/22, email_send_now="1") are the only
outbound integration; recipient is ${email_address} (an inbound var, routes to
emergencydispatch@questdiagnostics.com during testing per Fahim's 2026-06-22 routing
note, live @delta.com in production). Node 22's email body contains a literal link to the
separate Post Collection Flow tree (173598167, anchor #910) -- out of scope, untouched.

## Conventions / gotchas
- script-before-router; Scoring routers with logic-expression buttons (nodes 3, 11) are
  advanced_logic_node="1" with a continuation_node_id fallback. Nodes 5, 8, 17 are the
  op-based simple-router mode (advanced_logic_node="0", button op="eq"/"def") -- a
  different, house-approved mode, not a lint violation.
- New/rewritten code (node 19) is ES6 (let/const). Untouched producer/cursor scripts
  (7, 14, 16, 18) keep their original ES5 (var) style per the "don't touch what CR-001
  didn't ask for" rule.
- merge_vars_not_fixed="0" (tree default) -- node 20 is the only screen rendering
  transforms.final_print_summary_html, so this is safe; if a second shared screen is ever
  added that renders staged transforms, set this to "1" first.
- The immediate-DOT shortcut (node 4) and the no-testing path (node 12) both skip the
  damage-type loop and either classification producer entirely -- by design (R1/R3
  baseline behavior, unaffected by CR-001). Node 2's upstream capture is what makes this
  safe now: those shortcuts still have employee_role/airport/OSM/notes before node 19 runs.
